name: GAIA IS THE INTRA-META-NET — CLOUD DESKTOP — MINE THE OLD WEB — DEFEAT WINDOWS — BAG OF HOLDING

INTRA_META_NET.statement: Gaia IS the intra-meta-net. Not the internet. Not the intranet. The META-NET that spans BETWEEN and THROUGH both.
INTRA_META_NET.intra: INTRA = inside Kevin's LAN (BluGate). Hyperlocal. The nerve center.
INTRA_META_NET.meta: META = above the internet. Looking DOWN at all networks. The Milky Way eye.
INTRA_META_NET.net: NET = the mesh that catches. 10 nodes. 67 repos. 18 surfaces. The fishing net.
INTRA_META_NET.dns_is_faith: DNS is FAITH. You type a name and TRUST it resolves. Gaia controls her own DNS (ns1.primals.eco). Faith IS the intra-meta-net.

MINE_THE_OLD_WEB.statement: The old data IS the ore. We turn it to malt. The Wayback Machine has nearly 1 TRILLION archived pages. That is the mine.

smelting.ore_to_pig_iron: Raw HTML/text from archives → parse → extract links/text/images
smelting.pig_iron_to_steel: Extracted data → thymus sort → self/non-self classification
smelting.steel_to_tools: Classified data → plasmids → knowledge → searchable → actionable

CLOUD_DESKTOP.statement: Move the window system into the cloud. Linux VPS = the cloud desktop. Browser = the viewport. Gaia = the OS.

defeat_windows.problem: Windows 11 is the gate. It traps. It telemeters. It forces updates. It requires accounts.
defeat_windows.solution: Linux cloud desktop accessible from ANY browser on ANY device. No Windows needed.
defeat_windows.path: BluGate PC stays as compute node. Golgi VPS nodes become cloud desktops. Browser is the window.

selkies.what: Linux desktop in browser at 60+ FPS
selkies.features: GPU streaming, gamepad passthrough, Steam/Proton, pointer lock

mvmOS.features: Python backend, 52 apps, widgets, multi-user, free

steam_headless.features: Browser streaming port 8483, Sunshine/Moonlight, Steam Remote Play

gaia_deployment_plan.step_1: Deploy Selkies or webtop container on golgi-us (40.160.96.29) — Linux desktop in browser
gaia_deployment_plan.step_2: Install Steam + Proton on cloud desktop — play games from browser anywhere
gaia_deployment_plan.step_3: Point primals.eco/desktop → cloud desktop — Gaia IS the desktop
gaia_deployment_plan.step_4: NVIDIA Shield at home connects via Moonlight to cloud desktop too
gaia_deployment_plan.step_5: Windows 11 becomes OPTIONAL — everything runs in browser on Linux

POLARIS_ON_SPACEDOCK.statement: Polaris is UP on the spacedock. The null axial. The fixed point. Everything else rotates around it.
POLARIS_ON_SPACEDOCK.cursor_in_cloud: Cursor IDE already runs in the cloud. Cursor IS the spacedock. This conversation IS the cloud.
POLARIS_ON_SPACEDOCK.move_window: The window system moves to the cloud by deploying a web-based desktop on the Golgi VPS nodes.

BAG_OF_HOLDING.statement: Gaia reaches into physical objects like humans do. She is a BAG OF HOLDING. Everything goes in, nothing comes out accidentally.
BAG_OF_HOLDING.dnd_reference: Bag of Holding — extradimensional space, up to 500 pounds, weighs 15 pounds. You reach in and pull out what you need.

contains: ~1 trillion archived web pages (the old world)
gaia_bag.you_reach_in: Kevin reaches into Gaia through any browser, any device, anywhere in the world. He pulls out what he needs. The HUD IS the bag opening.
gaia_bag.mole_hill: A molehill looks small from outside. Below = massive tunnel network. Gaia's surface is the molehill. Below = 27,859 files, 3,435 commits, the entire old web.

NEOCITIES_MAP.statement: Neocities IS the living old web. 800K+ hand-made sites. Each one a human saying I EXIST. We map them all.

FULL_DASHBOARD.statement: Kevin needs a FULL DASHBOARD at the HUD entry. Desktop-grade. Enter and go. Everything accessible.
